game_title: Nested While Dungeon – Lantern Crossing Trial
game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Lantern Crossing, a rope bridge over a pit: the spelunker must handle zombies while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Nested While Dungeon: Run an inner loop for each room inside an outer loop for each floor.
theme: Shadow Cave – Lantern Crossing: a rope bridge over a pit
core_gameplay_loop: In Lantern Crossing, repeat each round: Run an inner loop for each room inside an outer loop for each floor. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the dungeon_clear value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the rope bridge using at most 14 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The rope bridge reached with actions_used <= 14.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 14 before the rope bridge is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 8 (extended tier): Nested While Dungeon
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
